messages:
alex: thinking out loud — we need a single export surface that ties routing policy changes, quota edits, and rollout events together so compliance can answer 'who changed routing for tenant X during a canary' quickly. current exports are fragmented.
maya: +1. do we want streaming (SSE/webhook) or snapshot NDJSON download? both use cases exist: live ops vs legal requests.
serena: my vote: canonical NDJSON stream for long-term archival (append-only), plus on-demand signed snapshot for eDiscovery. stream gives low-latency correlation to telemetry.
samir: quick note about schema: include these fields at minimum: event_id, timestamp, actor_id, actor_type (user/service), actor_identity_map (SAML/SCIM), target_resource, change_type, before, after, justification, rollout_id, trace_id, release_tag, metadata. also add schema_version.
alex: agree. also need diff-friendly "before"/"after" shapes, but avoid huge nested blobs for big policy objects. maybe store a compact delta plus a pointer to full JSON in objectstore.
maya: example NDJSON event shape we sketched in infra sync:

```json
{"schema_version":"audit_v3","event_id":"evt_01","ts":"2026-03-15T10:12:03Z","actor":{"id":"u_123","type":"user","identity":"alice@acme.com"},"resource":{"type":"routing_policy","id":"policy_77"},"change":{"type":"modify","delta":"{...compact diff...}","full_obj_url":"s3://audit-blob/policy_77/2026-03-15.json"},"rollout":{"id":"rl_999","stage":"canary","target":"tenant:acme"},"trace_id":"t-0a1b2c"}
```

serena: +1 on compact diff + blob. For PII we should support redaction modes in export: full, hashed, pseudonymized, redacted. and the export call should accept a redaction policy param.
samir: for streaming consumers, we also need a monotonic sequence number per-tenant or per-resource to allow clients to resume without missing reorderings.
alex: console UX — show a compact timeline for a resource: timeline rows should surface actor, change summary, rollout link clickable (opens rollout view), and a download arrow to export that range. add a filter for 'justification present / absent'.
maya: performance/op note: NDJSON downloads should be generated async. large tenant requests must be subject to export quota & cost approval. propose "export-tokens" that gate heavy downloads and are rate-limited.
serena: on retention & legal holds: exports must honor retention overrides (legal_hold=true). also add signed manifests with hash + signed-by-key to prove integrity for audits.
alex: API sketch for signed snapshot: POST /v1/audit/exports
body: {"resource_filter":"tenant:acme","from":"...","to":"...","redaction":"pseudonymize","include_blobs":true}
returns: 202 + job_id -> poll GET /v1/audit/exports/:job_id -> {status, download_url, signature}
samir: small detail: include the service principal that triggered automated rollouts (k8s-controller) as actor_type=service so we don't attribute to a user accidentally.
maya: we should add a telemetry join key in every event (span_id / trace_id) so ops can correlate with latency/cost telemetry and derive impact of routing changes.
serena: question: should we sign SSE events? maybe not each event but provide checkpoint manifests signed periodically, plus sequence numbers.
deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: audit-export-worker v2 -> 2026-03-15T10:18:30Z :rocket:
alex: next steps: write a short RFC that defines schema_v3, export API, redaction modes, and console wiring. samir + serena to prototype NDJSON producer; maya to mock console timeline. I'll own the RFC draft.
maya: i'll add mockups for the timeline and the export modal by EOW.
serena: i'll start a small PoC that streams compact diffs into S3 + checkpoint manifests.
samir: will scope perf tests for sequencing/resume semantics.
alex: thanks — tagging @security for review of PII modes and @legal for download retention flow when RFC is ready.
